cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay a minute. I taught you to check every date before booking. Our wedding invitations say Friday; this agreement says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've learned to check the price. Now finish the exercise: when did Friday become Monday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: After we sent the invitations. I haven't told anyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're not finished here. Get the guest list out and show me who you meant to tell first. Start with the people flying in.

reason: Make pupil correction and remembered practice determine A method of pursuing this exact Drive. Preserve the responsive core while giving B an immediate stake and A a spoken purpose beyond demonstrating the cards.
